newsitem.title: UK: Kenwood says has received no formal offer.
newsitem.headline: Kenwood says has received no formal offer.

text.p: Kenwood Appliances Plc, which faces moves by rebel shareholders aimed at soliciting a buyer for the company, said on Tuesday it had received no formal offer.

"The Kenwood board has noted the interest expressed by Pifco (Holdings Plc) as reported in yesterday's Financial Times. I can confirm, however, that no formal offer for the company has been received," David Nash, who became chairman today, said in a statement with half-year results.

The Financial Times said on Monday that Pifco, a smaller household appliances than Kenwood, was seeking to acquire Kenwood and quoted Pifco chairman Michael Webber saying that there was "sound commercial and industrial logic for putting the two companies together."

On December 16, Kenwood faces an extraordinary general meeting requisitioned by rebel shareholders who have put a resolution that the directors be required to hold discussions with third parties aimed at soliciting a bid for the company.
